The Monster of Temple Peak'' |writer=[[Cavan Scott]]{{SWYouTube|uILPgvzj708|Star Wars: The High Republic | Live Stream Launch Event}} |penciller=[[Rachael Stott]] |inker=Rachael Stott |letterer=[[Johanna Nattalie]] |colorist=*[[Vita Efremova]] *[[Nicola Righi]] |cover artist=Rachael Stott |editor=*[[Heather Antos]] (1-4) *[[Riley Farmer]] (3) |publisher=[[IDW Publishing]]{{SW|url=news/first-look-inside-star-wars-the-high-republic-the-monster-of-temple-peak|text=Get Your First Look Inside ''Star Wars: The High Republic: The Monster of Temple Peak''}} |start date=[[August 11]], [[2021]]{{Comixology|url=Star-Wars-The-High-Republic-Adventures-The-Monster-of-Temple-Peak-1-of-4/digital-comic/946350|text=Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures—The Monster of Temple Peak #1 (of 4)}} |end date=[[November 17]], 2021{{SW|url=news/the-monster-of-temple-peak-4-exclusive-preview|text=Ty Yorrick Strikes in IDW's ''The Monster of Temple Peak'' #4 – Exclusive Preview}} |schedule= |format=Miniseries |issues=4 |timeline=[[231 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures — The Monster of Temple Peak'' to [[231 BBY]]. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures — The Monster of Temple Peak''''' is a comic miniseries by [[Cavan Scott]] with artwork by [[Rachael Stott]]. It is part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project and is set just before ''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]''. Published by [[IDW Publishing]], the series was released over four issues and began its run on [[August 11]], [[2021]].
